summary: Classified both popup Capture page launch-intent removals as internal cleanup in the destructive-operations registry and gave the nested claim callback a popup-specific name. The discovery and confirmation guard remains unchanged.

diagnosis.reproduced_failure: The full single-worker suite found clearCapturePagePanel and takePopupLaunchTarget unregistered in tests/unit/destructive-confirm-guard.test.ts; all other tests passed apart from three explicit dev-clone database skips.
diagnosis.removed_data: Only extension-owned chrome.storage.session keys under matrx.sidepanel.popup_launch_intent, each containing a short-lived per-window Capture page route request.
diagnosis.clear_path: A failed popup launch removes the request key minted for that click after its write settles; a newer click has a different request key.
diagnosis.claim_path: The sidepanel selects the newest valid request for its own window, then consumes that window's valid route-request snapshot before routing to Scrape.
diagnosis.user_impact: These removals do not delete saved captures, account data, or user content. A failed cleanup can leave a temporary route request, and a failed claim returns no route target.

repair_round_1.targeted_result: The first targeted run passed 12 tests and failed discovery once: the AST scanner reports the nearest assigned callback name, claim, at launch-intent.ts:90, rather than the exported takePopupLaunchTarget wrapper. The first registry attempt therefore did not satisfy the actual guard.
repair_round_1.change: Renamed the nested callback to claimPopupLaunchTarget and registered that specific callback. A generic claim registry entry would permit unrelated cleanup functions to escape the census.
repair_round_1.peer_review: The first source peer missed this mismatch; a fresh Sol reviewer accepted the corrected source.

sibling_census: Other chrome.storage.session removals already have registry entries for one-shot drafts, auth attempts, auth adapters, and credential-capture bookkeeping. No second unregistered popup cleanup path was found.
existing_behavior_guards: tests/unit/popup-capture-route.test.tsx covers one-shot and window-scoped claims, concurrent claims, failed-click isolation from newer requests, and failed removal.
tests/unit/destructive-confirm-guard.test.ts discovers removal primitives across src and requires every owner to appear in the registry.

verification.targeted_result: Root-run targeted suite passed 17/17, exit 0, zero errors on the current shared checkout.
verification.concurrent_context: A separate contributor added popup context-binding tests in commits 7c9e0d5 and ae0e27e during this lane; the final targeted run included the current popup suite after those commits.
